changelog.title: What's New
items: • Remove duplicate SeekButtonTarget.kt from app module
• Route playback through InnerTubeX with media headers
✨ Add player client headers, chunked data source and podcasts view model
✨ Add bottom playlist screen, library entries and settings toggle

changelog.title: Fixes
items: 🔧 fix(ci): Maven Central mirror + Gradle cache to avoid Robolectric 429
🔧 fix(shraddha): sanitize recommend auto_play; align router blank-URL notice test
🔧 fix(tests): force real org.json on unit-test classpath
🔧 fix(tests): resolve Shraddha JSON unit test failures
🔧 fix the build issue
🔧 fix(ci): harden Gradle retry classification, input handling, and permissions
🔧 Fix app unit test compilation and hidden quick-pick filter
🔧 Fix APK build and unit test failures
🔧 fix(playback): adaptive crossfade pre-arm, DAC guard and safer fade loop
🔧 fix(login): merge sign-in flow fixes and drop forced app restart
🔧 build: compile against SDK 37 and add signed or debug CI logic
🔧 Fix Echo branding in Wrapped share output and make the pure Kotlin canvas modules use explicit Kotlin JVM plugin declarations so Gradle resolves Kotlin build tool classpath reliably.
🔧 fix: align Gradle and Android SDK with working build
🔧 fix: resolve Android SDK 37 build failure
🔧 fix(build): compile against SDK 37 and add playback cutoff recovery
✨ Add innertubex dependency for stream resolver
